schemaStability: Additive changes only within a major version: new properties and new CSV columns (appended, never inserted); no property is ever newly required. `congress` is carried in the metadata and as the last CSV column so a downloaded copy says which Congress it describes.
title: Georgia Federal Delegation — Roll-call Votes
description: Roll-call votes for Georgia's federal delegation in the current Congress. SCOPE: every recorded roll call both chambers held, enumerated from the Clerk of the House's per-year roll files and the Senate's per-session vote index - including measures that failed, amendments, procedural motions and Senate nominations. A vote on anything other than a measure (a quorum call, a motion to adjourn, a nomination) has bill and billUrl null. Voice votes and unanimous-consent agreements are not recorded by name and cannot appear. yea/nay are chamber-wide totals.

votes.description: Vote catalog keyed by vote ID. House: H{year}_{roll4}; Senate: S{congress}_{session}_{roll5}.

yea.description: Chamber-wide yea total (all members, not just Georgia's).

memberVotes.description: Per-member vote records keyed by bioguideId.
